prompts.plate: Edit target: the provided Korean fantasy RPG top HUD mockup. Produce a production-ready blank HUD ornamental skin plate, as close as possible to this exact reference. Preserve its approximately 3:1 wide composition, gold leaf-and-diamond corner ornaments, violet double rails, dark purple interiors, left large square portrait frame, main wide rounded hero panel behind it, right large square minimap frame, inset gold currency frame, and separate bottom gold-leaf stage banner with a diamond at its top center. Remove ALL letters, Korean text, English text, numerals, labels, example values, star/sun glyph by name, plus button, all minimap tiles and markers, and the mage character. Remove the HP and EXP bars and heart and currency crystal too; those will be real live game objects. Leave clean empty dark purple areas everywhere these elements were. The portrait frame must be an empty purple inset with NO character. The map must be an empty purple inset with NO text or tiles. Currency frame must be empty with NO plus button. Bottom stage banner must be completely blank, but preserve its subtle dividing rule and all gold leaves, jewels and violet rim. Preserve every frame position and silhouette as closely as possible; do not invent extra frames or change the overall composition. Transparent background outside the assembled frames; panel interiors remain opaque dark purple (#21132f to #2a1f3f). No baked-in lettering, symbols, numbers or watermarks. Sharp polished game UI asset; minimize surrounding empty margins. This is one reusable HUD ornamental skin asset, not a finished screenshot.
